title: Encoding a junta core
statement: Let $r$ be a nonnegative integer, let $J$ be a subset of the coordinates $\{0,\ldots,r-1\}$, and let $g$ be a sign-valued Boolean function on the $r$-dimensional sign cube that depends only on coordinates in $J$. The binary encoding of $g$ equals the function that first restricts its input to the coordinates indexed by $J$, in their increasing order, and then evaluates the binary encoding of the corresponding core of $g$ on the $|J|$-dimensional sign cube.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued Boolean function $g$ on the $r$-dimensional sign cube
